description: Microsoft announced Windows 11, version 26H2. It's the next annual feature update for Windows 11. This update is built on the same servicing foundation as Windows 11, versions 25H2 and 24H2. It adds AI-powered actions in File Explorer. With this update, users can edit supported images or summarise documents stored on OneDrive and SharePoint through Microsoft Copilot without opening the files.
title: Windows 11 Version 26H2 Released With Taskbar Improvements, File Explorer Features, More

description: Samsung Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra and Galaxy Tab S12+ launched with Dynamic AMOLED 2X displays, measuring 14.6 inches and 12.6 inches, respectively. They run Android 17 with One UI 9. They feature the MediaTek Dimensity 9500 chipset and support Galaxy AI features. The Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra is 5.1mm thin. They offer IP68-rated water and dust resistance.
title: Samsung Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra, Galaxy Tab S12+ Launched With MediaTek Dimensity 9500 SoC: Price, Specifications

description: Wallets linked to the Bitget hack transferred about $3.9 million (roughly Rs. 37 crore) worth of Zcash to Ironwood, the network’s latest shielded pool. The three transactions moved 2,746 ZEC through two intermediate wallets. Around 15 percent of the stolen ZEC has now entered the privacy pool, while other funds have been moved across blockchains using swap services.
title: Bitget Hackers Transfer $4 Million to Zcash Privacy Pool to Hide Funds

description: Fireflies.ai has introduced Talk, a voice dictation feature for its Mac and Windows desktop apps. It lets users enter spoken text into applications such as email, Slack, documents, AI tools and CRM platforms, with support for more than 100 languages. Talk automatically adds punctuation and cleans up transcribed text, while Slack can turn spoken teammate or group names into @mentions. Fireflies says completed dictations remain on the user's device and are not stored on its servers or used to train its AI models.
title: Fireflies.ai Launches Talk for Voice Dictation Across Email, Slack, Documents and More

description: Xbox has begun rolling out its disc-to-digital feature to all users. The feature allows users to digitise eligible Xbox One and Xbox Series X disc games. Users can insert the game disc into their Xbox console and obtain a digital license. Supported games also get digital benefits like Xbox Play Anywhere and Cloud Gaming.
title: Microsoft's Disc-to-Digital Program for Xbox Games Rolls Out to All Users

description: Jio has announced a limited-period anniversary offer on eligible JioBharat 4G phones, bundling six months of complimentary connectivity with the handset. The package provides 14GB of data every month and unlimited HD voice calls, while Jio estimates the effective device cost at Rs. 299 after accounting for the included recharge benefits. The company has not confirmed which JioBharat models qualify for the offer. JioBharat phones also support entertainment services, UPI payments and family-focused safety features.
title: Jio Offers JioBharat 4G Phones for Rs. 1,499 With 6 Months of Unlimited Calls and Data as Part of 10th Anniversary Offer

description: Oppo has added two more smartphones to its K15 lineup in China, with the K15s and K15x bringing different display and camera configurations to the series. The Oppo K15s uses a 6.57-inch AMOLED panel with a 120Hz refresh rate and a 50-megapixel rear camera. The Oppo K15x gets a larger 6.75-inch LCD screen and a 13-megapixel rear camera. Both models feature MediaTek chipsets, LPDDR4X RAM, UFS 2.2 storage and 45W SuperVOOC charging.
title: Oppo K15s, K15x Launched With Up to 8,000mAh Batteries, 120Hz Displays: Price, Features

description: While public companies routinely outline product risks to investors, few, if any, have issued warnings suggesting their technology could cause potential human extinction. Anthropic emphasized both the transformative potential of AI on par with industrialization and electricity and the irreversible harm it could cause if mishandled.
title: Anthropic Warns AI May Pose 'Existential Risks to Humanity' in IPO Filing

description: Kalshi has filed with the CFTC to terminate its Volume Incentive Program, with the change coming as the exchange faces scrutiny over more than $5 billion in near-identical Ether perpetual futures trades. September trading volume had already reached $52.98 billion by September 29, according to data cited by The Block. The CFTC review has not been described as a formal enforcement investigation.
title: Kalshi to Remove Volume Rewards as $5 Billion in Trading Faces Review

description: OpenAI has announced the ChatGPT Space feature. This tool lets users create and edit pages with ChatGPT, organise related content in dedicated spaces, and share pages or entire spaces with others. The company announced Spaces at the OpenAI DevDay 2026 event. It will be available soon for Enterprise and Business workspaces with data residency in Canada or the United Arab Emirates.
title: OpenAI Launches ChatGPT Space to Create, Organise Pages and Collaborate on Documents

description: HSBC has named its Hong Kong dollar-pegged stablecoin RedCoin ahead of its expected launch in the second half of 2026. The token has not yet been issued and will initially be available only through PayMe and the HSBC HK mobile app. Corporate and institutional applications are planned for later phases, although HSBC has not provided a timeline.
title: HSBC to Launch RedCoin Stablecoin in Hong Kong

description: Vivo X500 Pro surfaced on the NBTC website with model number V2621 and certificate number B38645-26. As per the listing, the handset supports GSM, WCDMA, LTE, and NR networks. The latest listing indicates that the Vivo X500 Pro will launch in Thailand soon. It was released in China earlier this month with a MediaTek Dimensity 9600 Pro chipset, triple rear cameras and a 6,510 mAh battery.
title: Vivo X500 Pro Appears on Thailand's NBTC Certification Database Ahead of Global Launch

description: OEMs raised the prices of their smartphones by 16 percent on average in India in the first half of 2026, according to Counterpoint Research. On the other hand, OnePlus raised the prices of its phones by 8 percent on average, which is half the industry average. On the contrary, it became the fastest-growing smartphone brand among the top five brands on online retail channels in the sub-Rs. 20,000 range in the second quarter of 2026. The report highlights that the sub-Rs. 10,000 price segment increased by 29 percent on average. This budget segment was the most affected by the price hikes in India in H1 2026. Meanwhile, the below-Rs. 45,000 price segment was the least affected, recording a 9 percent price rise on average in the given period.
title: India's Smartphone Prices Rose 16 Percent on Average in H1 2026, While OnePlus Took a ‘Different Route’: Counterpoint

description: After launching the Vivo Y600 Turbo and Y600i in China, the brand is reportedly ready to launch the Y600 globally. A phone with the model number V2626 has reportedly shown up on the Vivo console. A source claims that this is the Vivo Y600 5G, which will reportedly have the same specifications as the Vivo V80 Lite launched in Malaysia.
title: Vivo Y600 5G Listed on Google Play Console Revealing Key Specifications: What You Need to Know
Lighting Up the Season: The Ultimate Festival Gifting Guide

description: Apple Pay is now live in India, and users can start adding their eligible credit cards to use the contactless payment service. In India, Apple Pay only supports Axis Bank-issued Visa and Mastercard credit cards. However, the company is expected to onboard more banks and debit card issuers in the future. Apple Pay uses Near Field Communication (NFC) technology. Hence, you can tap-to-pay using your iPhone, Apple Watch, or iPad at an eligible PoS, which also has a compatible NFC-enabled device. Apple plans to bring Apple Pay support to Mac devices in India soon.
title: How to Set Up Apple Pay on iPhone in India: A Step-by-Step Guide

description: Apple support documentation on lossless audio playback through Apple Music suggests that Hi-Res Lossless is supported on Apple TV 4K models from the third generation onwards. This wording hints at the launch of the fourth-generation Apple TV 4K. It could come with an A19 series chipset. It could offer new Siri capabilities and include a Siri Remote. It is likely to feature up to 12GB of RAM.
title: Apple Support Page Hints at New Apple TV 4K; Launch Seems Imminent

description: Apple had reportedly considered cutting around 5,000 AppleCare support jobs as it explores greater use of AI across customer service. Bloomberg’s Mark Gurman also reports that CEO John Ternus is pushing for a leaner organisation, fewer management layers and a faster product development cycle. Apple is considering changes to its usual launch schedule and has already made cuts across several teams. The company is also reviewing spending, staffing and marketing plans for 2027 while seeking additional revenue from its existing products and services.
title: Apple CEO John Ternus-Led Overhaul Could Bring Faster Launches, Job Cuts: Mark Gurman

description: 007 First Light is getting a free DLC this week. IO Interactive has announced that the DLC will be released on October 1. 007 First Light launched on May 27 and has since sold over 4 million copies. The James Bond title is also among the year's highest-rated games. 007 First Light's upcoming DLC may also include other promised updates, like a New Game Plus mode.
title: IO Interactive Announces Free DLC for 007 First Light, Launch Set for This Week

description: Oppo F35 Pro 5G and Oppo F35 5G microsites have been updated to reveal their camera configuration and colour options. The Oppo F35 Pro 5G will be equipped with a dual rear camera system, headlined by a 50-megapixel primary shooter with optical image stabilisation (OIS) and a 1/2-inch sensor. The main camera will be paired with an 8-megapixel ultrawide camera on the back. The phone will be capable of recording up to 4K videos. On the other hand, the Oppo F35 5G will also boast a dual rear camera unit, featuring the same primary camera as the Pro model. However, instead of the 8-megapixel ultrawide shooter, the standard model will sport a 2-megapixel depth sensor on the back.
title: Oppo F35 Pro 5G, Oppo F35 5G Camera Configuration, Colour Options Revealed Days Before India Launch

description: Rockstar Games has shared new details about the setting of Grand Theft Auto 6 in a new Game Informer cover story. The developer has confirmed that the GTA 6 map is twice as large as GTA 5—the largest ever Rockstar has created. The map is also more detailed and includes a large number of explorable building interiors.
title: Grand Theft Auto 6's Map Is Twice as Large as GTA 5, Features Dynamic Weather System, Says Rockstar Games

description: A redesigned SmartThings app is rolling out to iPhone users with version 1.7.51. The company has launched the new interface on iOS before Samsung's own Galaxy smartphones and other Android devices. It uses Apple's Liquid Glass design language. Redesigned Home tab. It also allows users to control devices connected to the hub more quickly. It has a Routine Insights feature that shows your top three most frequently used Routines and their recent activity.
title: Samsung SmartThings Gets Major Redesign on iPhone With New Home Tab, Routine Insights Feature, and More

description: Vivo launched the X Fold 6 in China in June this year, and it's finally making its way to global markets. The global Vivo X Fold 6 has appeared in multiple leaks, revealing its storage variants and India launch date. The phone is now listed on a European retailer, and its specifications and colourways also reveal its expected price.
title: Vivo X Fold 6 Global Launch Nears as European Listing Reveals Price and Specifications

description: Google Fitbit Air has been launched in India, the company announced on Wednesday. This comes weeks after the company showcased its first screen-less fitness tracker in India during the Made by Google event on August 13. The new fitness tracker will go on sale in the country on October 2. The Google Fitbit Air will be offered in four colour options, namely Obsidian, Berry, Lavender and Fog. The company is also offering a three-month trial of Google Health Premium to provide access to Google Health Coach tools and features. Customers can avail a cashback of Rs. 1,000 with select HDFC Bank and ICICI Bank cards.
title: Google Fitbit Air Launched in India as Firm's First Screenless Fitness Tracker With Continuous Heart Rate Tracking, SpO2 Sensor: Price, Features

description: Flipkart Big Billion Days Sale 2026 will bring discounts on several Oppo smartphones, including the Find X9 Ultra, Find X9s, K14 5G, K14x 5G and K14 Lite. The sale prices start at Rs. 14,999, while the Find X9 Ultra gets the highest listed sale price at Rs. 1,53,000. Eligible Axis Bank and ICICI Bank cardholders can also claim up to 10 percent instant discounts. Early access begins on October 8, ahead of the main sale starting October 9.
title: Flipkart Big Billion Days Sale: Oppo Find X9 Ultra, K14x and Other More Phone Deals Revealed

description: Bitcoin is holding near $83,000 as expectations of an October Federal Reserve rate hike have fallen below 50 percent. Continued ETF inflows and lower derivatives leverage are helping support market stability, while traders await PCE inflation data and US payrolls for fresh clues on the Fed’s next move.
title: Bitcoin Stays Near $83,000 as October Fed Hike Odds Drop Below 50 percent

description: OpenAI has introduced ChatGPT Dots, AI agents designed to handle multi-step tasks across connected apps with limited user intervention. Dots can continue working in the background, return with updates or request approval when needed, and can be used for tasks ranging from software development and research to sales and content creation. Each agent gets a separate cloud computer and browser, while users can control its app access and permissions. OpenAI is also testing specialised Dots for business workflows and plans wider availability.
title: OpenAI Introduces ChatGPT Dots: 4000+ Apps Support, Availability, and More Explained

description: In the upcoming Flipkart Big Billion Days Sale, shoppers can expect deals on Samsung Galaxy smartphones. In addition to discounts, buyers can also benefit from bank offers, no-cost EMI plans, and exchange deals. Flipkart has yet to reveal the exact sale prices for the Galaxy S25, Galaxy S25 FE and others. The deals will be available from October 9, with early access beginning a day earlier for select shoppers. Samsung Galaxy S25 FE will be available below Rs. 50,000 in the upcoming sale.
title: Flipkart Big Billion Days Sale 2026: Samsung Galaxy S25, Galaxy S25 FE and More Teased to Get Discounts

description: Apple launched the iPhone Duo alongside its iPhone Pro models this year. Apple has marketed the product as its first-ever foldable device, so expectations are high. Since it is Apple’s first foldable, production reportedly can't keep up with Apple’s strict quality standards. This may lead to short supply and fewer devices when it goes on sale globally on October 23.
title: Apple iPhone Duo Could Face Limited Launch-Day Supply as Production Yields Remain Low

description: GPT-6.1 Sol AI model has been launched as the successor to GPT-6 Sol. The AI model was launched during OpenAI Dev Day 2026 on Tuesday. The new AI model is currently available to all Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise, and Edu users. Subscribers can access GPT-6.1 Sol via ChatGPT Work and Codex. However, it has yet to be released in Chat. Meanwhile, developers can access the AI model via the OpenAI API. OpenAI claims that GPT-6.1 Sol nearly matches the intelligence of the GPT-6 Astra AI model in agentic coding, computer use, and professional work. At the same time, GPT-6.1 Sol is claimed to be better than GPT-6 Sol at executing complex professional tasks, like writing and debugging code, understanding documents, and executing multi-step business workflows.
title: OpenAI’s GPT-6.1 Sol AI Model Launched With Near-GPT-6 Astra Intelligence at Significantly Lower Costs

description: Apple Pay has been launched in India in partnership with Axis Bank, the iPhone maker announced on Wednesday. The tap-to-pay service is now available for users via iPhone, iPad, and Apple Watch models. The tech giant says that soon Mac devices will also support Apple Pay in the country. With Apple Pay, users will be able to make contactless payments to online merchants, make in-app purchases, and tap-to-pay at Point-of-Sale (PoS) in physical stores with their Apple device, eliminating the need for you to carry a physical card.
title: Apple Pay Launches in India After 12 Years, With Axis Bank as Its First Partner

description: Google Pixel 11a will launch with a slightly larger rear camera module, as seen in the leaked CAD renders of the phone. Moreover, the Google Pixel 11a is shown to feature an LED flash next to the camera island. On the front, it could sport a flat display, surrounded by relatively thick bezels. A centred hole-punch display cutout appears at the top of the screen, which might house the selfie camera. The power button and volume controls could be placed on the right side of the phone. Meanwhile, a USB Type-C port, speaker grille, and a microphone cutout appear on the bottom.
title: Google Pixel 11a Design, Colour Options Spotted in Leaked Renders: Expected Specifications
